task_summary: Audited and resolved Landing-to-Login loading bar premature completion and route navigation latency. Synchronized TopProgressBar with React Suspense via useLayoutEffect and topProgress.isSuspended state. Implemented anticipatory route prefetching (routeRegistry with auth routes, hover/touch listeners, requestIdleCallback warmup), configured placeholderData and 3-minute staleTime in useTeams, optimized getMyTeam with .lean({ virtuals: true, getters: true }), and added covered compound indexes on Project and Team collections. Verified 100% test pass rate, UNMATCHED_COUNT=0, 60/60 agentic validation, and captured multi-viewport Playwright visual audit evidence.
